---
title: "HNSC Molecular Subtype Classification Report"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    theme: flatly
    highlight: tango
params:
  n_total: NA
  summary_table: NA
  sample_table: NA
  probs: NULL
  degs: NULL
  expr: NULL
  subtype: NA
  idType: "SYMBOL"
  has_probs: FALSE
  has_heatmap: FALSE
  has_degs: FALSE
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

if (!requireNamespace("HNSCclassifier", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop(
    "HNSCclassifier namespace is not available. ",
    "Install the package (remotes::install_github(...)) ",
    "or run devtools::load_all() during development."
  )
}

library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
```

---

## 1. Classification Summary

```{r summary-table}
cat("\nTotal samples classified:", params$n_total, "\n\n")
DT::datatable(
  params$summary_table,
  rownames = FALSE,
  options = list(dom = "t", paging = FALSE, ordering = FALSE),
  caption = "Molecular subtype distribution across all samples"
)
```

---

## 2. Subtype Distribution

```{r dist-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
subtype_colors <- c(
  Atypical    = "#87C304",
  Basal       = "#FC7C75",
  Classical   = "#1AD3D8",
  Mesenchymal = "#D880FF"
)
tbl <- params$summary_table
tbl$Subtype <- factor(tbl$Subtype,
                      levels = c("Atypical", "Basal", "Classical", "Mesenchymal"))
ggplot(tbl, aes(x = Subtype, y = N, fill = Subtype)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, colour = NA) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(N, " (", Pct, "%)")), vjust = -0.3, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = subtype_colors, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of Samples") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
```

---

## 3. Posterior Probabilities

```{r probs-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=max(5, params$n_total*0.12)}
if (params$has_probs) {
  HNSCclassifier::plot_subtype_probabilities(params$probs)
} else {
  cat("*(Probability matrix not provided; only class labels were available.)*")
}
```

---

## 4. Subtype Marker Gene Heatmap

```{r heatmap, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
if (params$has_heatmap) {
  HNSCclassifier::plot_subtype_heatmap(
    params$expr, params$subtype,
    idType = params$idType
  )
} else {
  cat("*(Heatmap skipped — expression matrix not provided.)*")
}
```

---

## 5. Differentially Expressed Genes

```{r degs, results='asis'}
if (params$has_degs) {
  for (nm in names(params$degs)) {
    cat("\n\n###", nm, "\n\n")
    df <- params$degs[[nm]]
    if (nrow(df) == 0) {
      cat("*(No genes passed the thresholds.)*\n\n")
    } else {
      df_sub <- head(df, 20)
      df_show <- df_sub
      colnames(df_show) <- c("Gene", "log2FC", "Mean (in)", "Mean (other)",
                             "p-value", "Adj. p-value")
      cat(
        knitr::kable(df_show,
                     format = "html",
                     align = "lrrrrr",
                     digits = c(NA, 2, 2, 2, 4, 4),
                     caption = paste0("Top ", min(20, nrow(df)),
                                      " DEGs for ", nm, " (one-vs-rest)"),
                     table.attr = 'class="table table-striped table-hover"'),
        "\n\n"
      )
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("*(Differential expression results not provided.)*")
}
```

---

## 6. Sample-Level Classification

```{r sample-table}
DT::datatable(
  params$sample_table,
  rownames = FALSE,
  options = list(pageLength = 15, searching = TRUE, scrollX = TRUE),
  caption = "Per-sample classification results"
)
```
